title: Project Context
subtitle: Save text specifications for this repository. PR brief generation includes their saved content within its input budget.

empty.title: No spec files yet
empty.body: Use the editor to save a PRD, technical spec, or acceptance criteria as text. The next explicit PR brief generation uses these saved attachments.

editor.title: Text spec editor
editor.pathHint: Use a repository-relative name. Saving the same path replaces its text; this does not read a file or watch a folder.
editor.invalidPath: Use a relative POSIX path of at most 256 characters, without empty, dot, parent, backslash, or control-character segments.
editor.invalidContent: Enter nonempty text of at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes.
editor.saveError: Couldn’t save the text spec. Your draft is retained
